title: AdaptManip: Learning Adaptive Whole-Body Object Lifting and Delivery with Online Recurrent State Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2602.14363v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper presents Adaptive Whole-body Loco-Manipulation, AdaptManip, a fully autonomous framework for humanoid robots to perform integrated navigation, object lifting, and delivery. Unlike prior imitation learning-based approaches that rely on human demonstrations and are often brittle to disturbances, AdaptManip aims to train a robust loco-manipulation policy via reinforcement learning without human demonstrations or teleoperation data. The proposed framework consists of three coupled components: (1) a recurrent object state estimator that tracks the manipulated object in real time under limited field-of-view and occlusions; (2) a whole-body base policy for robust locomotion with residual manipulation control for stable object lifting and delivery; and (3) a LiDAR-based robot global position estimator that provides drift-robust localization. translated_title: AdaptManip：基于在线循环状态估计的自适应全身物体搬运与递送学习
translated_abstract: 本文提出了自适应全身移动操作框架AdaptManip，这是一个完全自主的框架，使人形机器人能够执行集成的导航、物体抓举与递送任务。与以往依赖人类示教且对干扰较为脆弱的基于模仿学习的方法不同，AdaptManip旨在通过强化学习训练鲁棒的移动操作策略，而无需人类示教或遥操作数据。所提出的框架由三个相互耦合的组件构成：（1）循环物体状态估计器，可在有限视野和遮挡情况下实时跟踪被操作的物体；（2）用于鲁棒运动的全身基础策略，结合残差操作控制以实现稳定的物体抓举与递送；（3）基于激光雷达的机器人全局位置估计器，提供抗漂移的定位。所有组件均通过强化学习在仿真中训练并部署。
tldr: 本文提出完全自主的AdaptManip框架，通过强化学习（无需人类示教）将循环物体状态估计器、带残差操作控制的全身基础策略以及基于激光雷达的抗漂移定位相结合，使人形机器人能够鲁棒地执行导航、物体抓举与递送的集成任务。
en_tdlr: AdaptManip is a fully autonomous reinforcement learning framework that integrates a recurrent object state estimator, a whole-body locomotion policy with residual manipulation control, and LiDAR-based drift-robust localization, enabling humanoid robots to robustly perform navigation, object lifting, and delivery without human demonstrations or teleoperation data.
